steps.title: Eleven small steps
steps.body:
**major 7th** means an interval of eleven half steps. C up to B is a major 7th; the B is one half step below the next C.

**Why it matters:** This distance will supply an extra sound in a chord you will learn soon.

steps.title: See it on the fretboard
steps.body: C3 is string 5 fret 3. B3 is string 2 open. Play them one after another and compare B3 with the next C4.

items.prompt: Play C3, then go up a major 7th.

steps.title: Explore the sounds
steps.body: Play C3, B3, C4 slowly. The last half step completes the octave.
